item.title: Tsukutori
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: rúf
  • 発売日: 2007-05-25
  • スコア: 7.4/10 (44 人評価)
  • 日本語名: つくとり
  • 英語名: Tsukutori

あらすじ

Kaoru meets Kudou on his way to work. Kudou is on her way to the scene of the murder to investigate. By following her request, Kaoru starts to investigate the murder case with her, and they find another dead body hanged from a tree soon after. According to people living nearby, a hanged dead body is found every year around the annual festival. They treat it with care as a sacrifice to Tsukutori, the local deity. Kaoru and Kudou don’t believe it, but they face a series of mysterious accidents…

item.title: Yume Miru Kusuri
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: rúf
  • 発売日: 2005-12-22
  • スコア: 7.359999999999999/10 (6146 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ユメミルクスリ
  • 英語名: Yume Miru Kusuri

あらすじ

I am just an average student, living an average life. I study, I work my part-time job, and get through the day just like everyone else, trying not to be beaten down by the pressures of modern Japan. Then suddenly, the winds of change blow into my life, when I encounter three girls who reshape me forever. Three girls who are most definitely not living a normal life like everyone else in Japan, but who seem to float above society, strangely unaffected by it. Instinctively I know I should avoid getting involved with them, and yet before I know it, my destiny is bound with theirs. Where will it all lead?

  • 日本語名: 羞中恥療室
  • 英語名: Shuuchuu Chiryoushitsu

あらすじ

Makoto Sugiura has studied his whole life to become a doctor. He’s looking for revenge on the doctor with a scalpel scar across his left hand. It was that doctor who is responsible for his sister’s death. After finally being assigned to the right hospital, Makoto finds that the entire staff is involved in something suspicious. He decides to sleep his way to the truth, squeezing a confession out of one nurse after another until he makes his way to the top.

别名

  • Corruption

あらすじ

Koichi lost his mother as an infant, and his father remarried a woman with three daughters: Misaki, Haruka, and Ayano. Unfortunately, Koichi’s stepmother is killed in a traffic accident, and because of his job, his father is constantly on the road. Koichi and his stepsisters help each other and build a relationship that is even stronger than if they had been real brother and sisters.

あらすじ

A boy who lacks confidence ignores the feelings of his childhood friend and accepts the confession of another girl, but he can’t trust her feelings for him, so he uses information from a BDSM webpage to start training her into a sex slave, to test and see how obedient she’ll be.

The childhood friend, depressed and rejected, falls into the clutches of another boy who tricks and rapes her, then blackmails her to force her to go along with his own SM training plans.
